infographic.title: How Guided Wave Radar Works
infographic.alt: Infographic showing four steps of guided wave radar level measurement from pulse to level output
steps: The transmitter sends a low power radar pulse down the probe.
The probe acts as a waveguide and keeps the pulse focused.
Part of the pulse reflects where the dielectric constant changes.
Time of flight gives the distance, and the distance gives the level.
